rv.q: Crafting a story around campus culture wars without mentioning any significant topics of debate, while so many in the audience are collectively experiencing these things in our real lives, makes what ends up on stage feel hollow.
“The Humanities” is a riveting exploration of the cost of free speech.

cn.t: Victory Gardens returns with Dohrn's provocative, even-handed campus drama about controversial speakers that earns praise for its entertaining intellectual battles and cynicism about academic virtue signaling, though timing pressures reveal some limitations.
